lines.1: 「What?! Now we've got a bloomer thief?!」
lines.2: There sure had been a lot of perverts lately.
lines.3: Granted, our school was one of the few that still used bloomers.
lines.4: I could understand the temptation, but that didn't make it forgivable.
lines.6: 「Someone spotted him and now he's running for the school gates. After him!」
lines.8: 「Wait, why are you covered in bruises?」
lines.9: 「I hit Yashi and Princess with a flying cross chop, so they beat the crap out of me.」
lines.12: 「Oh, now he's got a car? This guy came prepared.」
lines.13: 「Hmph. Camouflage to infiltrate the school this time. He's getting elaborate!」
lines.15: 「No one who disturbs our peaceful lives will go unpunished.」
lines.17: 「Hey, Kurogane! The director heard the commotion and sent me with a message.」
lines.18: 「Has he authorized me to draw my sword?」
lines.21: 「Make it spectacular. He says a fire would set a fine example.」
lines.23: 「Leo, stay back where it's safe. I'm going to make this flashy.」
lines.25: With animal agility, she overtook the car.
lines.27: Forget a bicycle--she could keep pace with a car.
lines.28: Stay back where it's safe, she said.
lines.29: Otome was the one getting way too fired up.
lines.30: After passing the car, she cut across its path.
lines.31: 「Stealing underwear is the work of a twisted coward!」
lines.33: 「What the hell?! If you stand in my way, I'll run you over! Fwaow!」
lines.34: 「Don't be crazy! I may love bloomers, but I draw the line at assault! Fwaow!」
lines.35: The moment the car swerved to avoid Otome--
lines.40: As the ancient chronicles tell it--
lines.41: The blades they wielded on the battlefield could cleave even armor of iron with ease.
lines.42: Such power truly made each one worth a thousand warriors.
lines.43: The car burst into flames as she sliced past it.
lines.44: That sword... No wonder Otome hardly ever drew it. She practiced iaijutsu.
lines.45: 「Director, the matter is handled. The man inside is alive... though unconscious.」
lines.46: 「Good. Even that thing--Hell Butterfly--will grow dull if it doesn't cut something now and then.」
lines.48: 「We shall leave the rest to the police.」
lines.49: The police were in for quite a surprise.
lines.52: The huge crowd of onlookers applauded too.
lines.53: And so, Otome was popular with boys and girls alike.
lines.56: 「After what you did today, wasn't your shoe locker overflowing with love letters? It looked like something out of a manga.」
lines.57: 「Yes. Reading them all was quite a task.」
lines.61: Otome pulled me firmly against her.
lines.62: 「I've told you before: you're the only one for me.」
lines.65: 「You worked hard at training today. I'm proud of you. Now all that's left is a good night's sleep.」
lines.67: Stern to the end, yet gentle.
